title: La conquista del Perú
goal: Read how fewer than 200 Spaniards captured an empire in crisis, from the Cajamarca ambush to a resistance state that survived four decades longer than most people assume.

items: Explain what condition the Inca empire was in when Pizarro arrived.
Explain what Atahualpa offered for his freedom, and whether the Spanish honored it.
Explain whether Atahualpa's baptism changed the outcome of his sentence.
Describe what happened after Atahualpa's execution, up to 1572.
Use the se-passive to narrate historical events without naming who did them.
